kpis.description_fr: Net adds postpaid phones FY24. Sortie d'une période négative (2020-2022), retour à la croissance positive grâce repositionnement myPlan + C-band 5G.
kpis.description_en: Net adds postpaid phones FY24. Exit from negative period (2020-2022), return to positive growth thanks to myPlan repositioning + C-band 5G.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu service wireless FY24. Cœur du business (~60% CA consumer). Croissance modérée par hausse ARPA + 5G premium.
kpis.description_en: Wireless service revenue FY24. Core business (~60% consumer CA). Moderate growth through ARPA hike + 5G premium.

kpis.description_fr: Abonnés Fixed Wireless Access (5G/4G home internet) FY24. Croissance forte, déjà 4.6M, cible 8-9M en 2028. Substitut cable.
kpis.description_en: Fixed Wireless Access subscribers (5G/4G home internet) FY24. Strong growth, already 4.6M, targeting 8-9M by 2028. Cable substitute.

kpis.description_fr: Taux de churn postpaid phones mensuel FY24. Best-in-class US wireless (vs T-Mobile ~0.88, AT&T ~0.95). Indicateur stickiness.
kpis.description_en: Postpaid phones monthly churn rate FY24. Best-in-class US wireless (vs T-Mobile ~0.88, AT&T ~0.95). Stickiness indicator.

kpis_story.description_fr: Annonce sept 2024 : acquisition Frontier $20Mds. Ajoute 7.2M passings fibre, accélère stratégie convergence wireless+fiber. Closing prévu 2026.
kpis_story.description_en: Sep 2024 announcement: Frontier acquisition $20Bn. Adds 7.2M fiber passings, accelerates wireless+fiber convergence strategy. Closing expected 2026.

_notes: US telecom #1. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
